exposure: Positive epidermal growth factor receptor mutation
cohort: A 28-year-old nonsmoker pregnant female diagnosed with lung adenocarcinoma with positive epidermal growth factor receptor mutation.
finding: This case highlights the rare occurrence of lung adenocarcinoma with a positive epidermal growth factor receptor mutation during pregnancy, leading to rapid progression and maternal death shortly after delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed at 32 weeks of pregnancy.
